_: Cards of the reusable parts of this folder (node step 725-1). One card per part; the map is lib/parts/PARTS.json.

what.en: The common steps of a setup ladder for an outside provider (Google, Resend …): numbered steps, a line to copy with its button, the limits note.
what.ru: Общие ступени лестницы настройки внешнего провайдера (Google, Resend …): шаги с номерами, строка для копирования с кнопкой, заметка об ограничениях.

parts.how: Compose a provider's setup screen from Step, StepPoints, CopyRow, RouteLine and LimitsNote instead of laying steps out by hand.

what.en: The green or red notice «you are signed in as …» that greets a person where they arrive after the sign-in service.
what.ru: Зелёная или красная плашка «вы вошли как …», которая встречает человека там, куда он пришёл после службы входа.

parts.how: Mount <SignInNotice /> once in a layout with the SIGN_IN_TOASTER; its words come from sign-in-notice.i18n on the server.
